attempts.prompt:
Create a professional bichon frise WALK RIGHT eight-frame animation sheet, TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, 4x2 equal SQUARE cells, 1536x768 landscape. Dog identity/style from supplied references: round fluffy white head, curly white realistic fur, short ears, black eye/nose, red collar with gold yellow bell, curled tail. Strict RIGHT facing side profile in ALL eight frames, nose right, tail left. Head is unchanged, body compact and realistic, natural legs underneath.
PRIORITY: Eight DIFFERENT sequential animation poses, full cyclic alternating four-legged walk. NO duplicated forward-reaching front leg in every frame. The NEAR front leg must complete its whole forward-to-backward step. Reading cells top left to bottom right:
1 near front paw reaches forward RIGHT and makes ground contact; near rear paw behind to LEFT; other two opposite.
2 near front paw is beneath shoulder; near rear lifts and moves toward body.
3 near front paw is BEHIND shoulder to LEFT; near rear swings toward RIGHT.
4 near front paw pushes behind body to LEFT and lifts; near rear reaches forward RIGHT and lands.
5 near front paw lifted and bends under chest; FAR front paw reaches forward RIGHT, near rear moves behind.
6 near front paw passing under chest; far front paw underneath shoulder; near rear paw under hips.
7 near front paw swings forward RIGHT while FAR front paw is BACK to LEFT; near rear behind LEFT.
8 near front paw nearly contacts forward RIGHT to join smoothly to frame1; far front pushes back.
The head and torso and tail are visually FIXED across frames, only leg articulation and tiny natural bob. Legs have modest bent joints and VERY SHORT stride, not exaggerated stretching or running. Preserve FOUR paws, hide far upper limbs naturally behind the body. Grounded calm walk, leg actions are incremental and smooth.
Each dog centered identically within its cell, SAME SCALE and SAME FRAME coordinates. Every dog's top of head y=48 and paw contact baseline y=340 in its384x384 local square cell; nose x=342, tail x=38. SAME vertical registration in BOTH ROWS, no shift on bottom row. Every dog fully isolated in its cell with 30 pixels minimum transparent margin; no clipping.
Fine realistic soft white curls, gentle dimensional studio lighting and crisp attached fur tips. Transparent empty areas must be clean alpha0. NO backdrop or checkerboard texture or white matte, no floor, ground shadow, text, labels, grid, borders, unrelated specks, head turn or extra legs.

Create a TRANSPARENT PNG 8-frame right-walking bichon frise sprite sheet. Four columns, two rows, landscape 2:1 image, 1536x768 preferred. Eight equal 384x384 square cells. TRANSPARENT PADDING IS CRITICAL: dog in each cell is SMALLER, only 280 pixels wide and 245 pixels tall; center dog at x192,y204. Nose must end at x332, tail must begin at x52, top of head y80, foot contact baseline y325. 50 pixels of empty transparent padding on both left and right sides of EVERY cell. Never let any dog pixels cross a cell boundary. All eight dogs same size and same registration.
Same realistic white curly-fur bichon from reference photos, round head, small floppy ears, black eye and nose, red patterned collar, small yellow bell, curled tail, healthy normal dog anatomy with distinct moderate legs below belly. Precise side profile facing RIGHT in every frame. Cute realistic plush fine curls, soft diffuse lighting, fine fur edges; no cartoon or flat illustration.
Eight smoothly progressing phases of ONE natural relaxed four-legged walk IN PLACE. Slightly different leg pose every frame. Head/torso position fixed. Animate near FRONT paw from forward ground contact (1), beneath shoulder (2), behind shoulder (3), lifted behind (4), bent passing under chest (5), swinging forward (6), reaching front (7), ready to contact (8). Near BACK leg does opposite phase and far legs alternate with near legs. Four anatomically correct legs, small natural paw lifts and short stride, modest body bob. No stretching body or leaps. Frame8 joins frame1 continuously.
Create ONLY the isolated dog silhouettes on actual transparent alpha0 surroundings. No ground, shadow, scenery, gridlines, labels, numbers, text, extra pixels, checkerboard texture or watermark. Keep ALL full silhouettes including nose tail and paws within their own individual square cells with generous clear padding.
